_comment: Per-country content. "categories" = Home screen category chips; "music_categories" = category chips on the Music (song) tab - songs only, NO movie chips; "music_singers" = singers shown on the Music tab. Just add a name to any list - the app finds its videos/songs by itself (news/sports/trending are auto-localised to this country). Optional: "category_queries" lets you set your own search queries for a specific name. Upload as countries/NP.json on GitHub.
